title: Completely free buttttt…
body:
Ok don’t get me wrong, this app is good. It’s free, it’s, designed to help people with ADHD, what’s not to love? Well as someone who finds it hard to focus (I might have adhd idk if I do) it’s kinda confusing. You can change the font and colour theme, but not a lot else. You can set focus sessions, and you can set tasks as well. However, there’s an option where you can block ALL OF YOUR APPS and GIVE YOURSELF A SCREEN TIME LIMIT FOR THEM ALL!!!!! I don’t really like that feature if you can’t tell. I know, I know, it’s optional, but if you truly have adhd it’s gonna be hard to resist tapping the button that says: OVERRIDE BLOCK IN FIVE SECONDS!
I mean come on

Sorry if you find this offensive 🥲
author: Ivy c-b’s reviews
